# Copilot instructions

Review pull requests per `.agents/docs/code-review.md`.

This is a private fork (see `AGENTS.md` § "This fork"); fork docs and skills are indexed in
`docs/README.md`. For diffs under `apps/deploy/`, `.github/workflows/`, `client-patches/`, `docs/`,
or custom content, check them against the doc `docs/README.md` names for that area.

Instructions about the review's format or its overview comment are
[unsupported](https://docs.github.com/en/copilot/tutorials/customize-code-review#unsupported-instruction-types)
and do not belong here.
